title: Ring beam: T1 variations
desc: Three new builds of 830 T1 (hex flow + sparks): hex prism with spark rings, hex collars over a fast core, and a spinning hex screw with an impact fountain.

takes.name: hex prism + spark rings
takes.facts: 6-faced hex prism sheath turning against the helix; rings of 8 sparks burst outward, running down the beam

takes.name: hex collars + trailing sparks
takes.facts: thin fast hex core inside a train of short 6-sided hex collars sliding along; sparks peel off the collars' back edges

takes.name: hex screw + impact fountain
takes.facts: hex rows wind round the beam and the sheath spins like a drill; spark fountain kicked back off the wall, crackle along the length
